_comment: Push (outside the player's quiet hours) for what needs attention: a horde due at your village within `waveWarningHours` game hours, a battle at your village, a raided outpost, an Elder's Hall level or any building reaching `bigBuildLevel`. Everything else waits for the daily digest at the player's digest hour. Pushes not sent within `pushExpiryHours` real hours are dropped. Players switch pushes off by `topics`, each a group of notice kinds; a notice of a kind in no topic always goes.
